svg.title: Study Hub: a single file study dashboard for researchers and students, built for cognitive science. Stuck on a topic? Type it once and get a plain language explanation and the top papers on one page, then keep a focus timer, tasks, a reading list and notes next to them. A search box shows the example query predictive coding. Facts: 1 HTML file, no install and no account, 8 top papers per search drawn from 250M+ scholarly works on OpenAlex. Animated focus timer card: a ring counts down a 25 minute focus session, with 25, 50, 5 and 15 minute modes.

div.p: A single file study dashboard for researchers and students, built for cognitive science. A focus timer, tasks, a reading list and notes sit right next to your search.
